test_cases.path_step: A Teacher updates the description of an upcoming session by navigating to the 'Sessions' tab, clicking the 'Edit' button next to a session, modifying the session data, and clicking 'Save'.
test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 4: Teacher Responds and Updates the Course
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Updates an Existing Session's Description
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher (GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com) is logged in and has navigated to the 'Course Details Page' for the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course. At least one session, 'Introduction to Software Testing', is listed under the 'Sessions' tab.
test_cases.expected_result: The session description is successfully updated in the database. The system displays the updated session list, showing the modified description, and notifies the Teacher of the successful update.
test_cases.post_condition: The session 'Introduction to Software Testing' in the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course has its description updated to 'This session covers basic software testing concepts.'.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Sessions' tab to view course sessions.
Click the 'Edit' button next to the 'Introduction to Software Testing' session.
Enter 'This session covers basic software testing concepts.' into the 'Session Description' field in the 'Modify Session' modal.
Click the 'Save' button to submit the changes.

test_data_fields.field_value: This session covers basic software testing concepts.

test_cases.groups_involved: Session Management Actions, Existing Session Actions, Create New Session, Edit Existing Session
